message: ９９年の謙虚

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. How do you think we can bring Azel into our circle of friends?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Isn't that just 'a small kindness, a huge bother'? Some folks just want to be left alone, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but... oh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today is a lovely day for a walk, isn't it?」
Taking a walk together? They've finally gotten that close. Expect nothing less from the Student Council Secretary!

name: Synn
message: 「How wonderful it is when people get along.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No matter how you look at it, that's not what's happening.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The sun is so nice and warm, it really puts a spring in your step, doesn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「All I see is an angel clinging onto a mysterious transfer student.」

name: Synn
message: 「At least tone it down to 'tagging along' for her sake.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san. I don't think it's good for you to always look like you have nothing to do.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I read somewhere that the time of one's youth is more precious than grains of sand made of diamonds.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you have free time, I think you should join a club or something. If you just keep joining and quitting over and over, you're bound to find one that suits you, Azel-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And that, in short, is the voice of experience!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you don't know what kinds of clubs there are, I'll introduce them to you with a ba-ba-ba-bang!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, having joined and quit thirty different clubs, I am the self-proclaimed and universally recognized Club Queen.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, what kind of club would you like? One that gets your blood pumping and your heart racing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Or one with a bit of a mysterious air about it? Or perhaps the kind where people sit and chat quietly?」
Hmm. I can tell Lolotte is trying hard, but how should I put it--he clearly looks annoyed.
Well, from an outsider's perspective, what I've been doing to Azel probably looks the exact same way.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello there, Lolotte. Azel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, President!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmph-hmph. We're already besties now, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「...No, it sure doesn't look like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your eyes are like microscopes, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're going to use that idiom, it's 'knotholes.'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come now, we're already best friends, aren't we, Aze-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Trying to make friends is fine, but forcing it isn't good.」
Not that I'm one to talk, though.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm not forcing anything. I'm being careful and subtle.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Didn't the Chairwoman tell us to subtly look out for him?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, you're being ridiculously blatant, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your eyes really are microscopes, Mr. President. You're blowing tiny details out of proportion. Besides, sometimes a little pushiness is necessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. True enough.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「According to my years of observation, Azel doesn't seem to have gotten close to anyone, which is a most regrettable situation.」
I agree, though...

name: Synn
message: 「Listen. Saying that right in front of the person himself is what's blatant.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A human... awawa!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You should enjoy this country--or rather, this academy life--much more. It's super fun here, after all. Especially Student Council activities.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not listening to a word I say, are you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How rude of you, Mr. President. I hear you faintly in the background, like the babbling of a little brook.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In other words, what I'm trying to say is: you came all this way from Tang and India to fetch precious sutras, so it's a waste to always wear a sour face.」

name: Synn
message: 「He didn't come here to fetch sutras.」

name: Azel
message: 「What are sutras?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's your problem right there. When you have a question, you have to look it up yourself. That way you'll get bogged down in knowledge and the world will become much more fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. That's actually a decent point... wait, 'get bogged down'?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not interested enough to go out of my way to look it up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you're a lazybones, huh. But don't worry. When it comes to being lazy, I won't lose to anyone either. Ahem!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For someone like that, this guidebook will come in handy. Most things are written right here. In this 'True Stories: The Human World'!」

name: Synn
message: 「It sounds super shady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not true at all! 'True Stories: The Human World' is a tenka...

name: Lolotte
message: Awawa, ahem!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Setting that aside, every single day has been super happy for me since I joined the Student Council」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, I have a brilliant idea! Azel should join the Student Council too. If she does, a happy, sparkling, heart-pounding school life will begin」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Where's Azel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is this the ninja art of vanishing into thin air?!」

name: Synn
message: 「She gave us the slip? Could she be a secret agent?!」
But where to?!

name: Lolotte
message: 「At times like this, asking Kokkuri-san is the best way」

name: Synn
message: 「We won't be able to catch up to her while we're preparing all that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, that's mine. Yes, hello」

name: Riesling
message: 「If it is tracking an agent, please leave it to me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Where on earth did you come from?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya, do you know where Azel is?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Distance: 138 yards. She has entered the new school building's entrance and is heading toward the stairs」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you, Jiiya」

name: Riesling
message: 「Not at all, Milady. Should you ever be in trouble, please do not hesitate to call upon me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「Where on earth did he come from?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you sweat the small stuff, you lose」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haa, haa... T-Trying to shake me off, haa, she's n-ninety-nine years too early」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa, why ninety-nine years...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wheeze, wheeze, I am humble」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a second!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Is there some reason you can't fit in with that class? I think they're all good people, though」
Apparently, it's quite common for transfer students to struggle to blend into new social circles over trivial misunderstandings.

name: Azel
message: 「There isn't」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Trying to dodge the question is useless. Unlike the president's eyes, mine aren't microscopes, so I see everything crystal clear」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is a huge problem. I have never once seen Azel-san talking to anyone」

name: Synn
message: 「True. Even in the classroom」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Furthermore, not attending classes is unacceptable! Why, just the other day, you were at the church right in the middle of class hours, weren't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right. You're barely ever around during class time」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The church is not pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「No, does he mean classes are pointless?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even I, who am always sleeping, at least make a point of attending class」

name: Synn
message: 「Stay awake」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The president has high standards. In that case, please show me through actions rather than words」

name: Synn
message: 「Actions?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I should inadvertently fall asleep during class, I would appreciate it if you could gently wake me up without anyone noticing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「While you're at it, telling me which textbook page is currently being explained in the lesson would earn you a 'good job'」

name: Synn
message: 「...We aren't even in the same grade to begin with」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You just dodged a bullet, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「How did you know Azel was at the church anyway?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sleeping at the church is truly a rare occasion, to the point of having scarcity value」

name: Synn
message: 「That's still no good」
Just as Lolotte says, there's no sign of Azel getting friendly with anyone.
Besides, he's not even in the classroom during breaks.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, since you get to spend time with so many people your own age, you should at least try to make some friends.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, friendships aren't something you force, they just happen naturally... But still, if you miss your chance, nothing's ever going to happen.」

name: Synn
message: 「With the way you acted when everyone came up to talk to you on your first day after transferring, too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Meaningful interactions begin by answering when someone asks you a question.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's a nuisance.」
Hmm. He's a tough nut to crack.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel, could it be that you're holding back from making friends out of consideration for a close friend back in your hometown!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have a dear friend of my own. Though we're under distant skies now and cannot meet,」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sure she would be much happier knowing I'm with friends rather than all alone.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, we have to move classrooms for the next period! I need to hurry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No skipping class, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm actually more worried about you on that front, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll come see you again later, Azel! Make sure you go to class!」
Well, guess I should get going too. Before that, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「You might find her annoying, but please don't hate Lolotte.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's genuinely worried about you.」

name: Azel
message: 「How can you tell?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, anyone could tell, just from the way she acts.」

name: Azel
message: 「I can't tell.」

name: Azel
message: 「She is another person.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, sure, you can't understand someone completely, but if you spend time together, you get a pretty good idea, right? Especially with someone as easy to read as Lolotte.」

name: Azel
message: 「How much do you actually know about that girl?」

name: Synn
message: 「...What do you mean, 'how much'?」
Unusually enough, Azel was looking straight at me.
Th-This is my chance for some meaningful communication!

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte Rosenkreuz. She's a rich girl and a returnee from abroad. She has a butler of unfathomable skill named Riesling Tooyama, and of course, she's filthy rich」

name: Synn
message: 「That piggy bank of hers is especially terrifying. Believe it or not, it's filled strictly with 500-yen coins! Just thinking about how much is inside sends shivers down my spine」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, even just one of them is 500 yen! And 500 yen is big money, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, that's not the important part. We only just met, sure, and she might seem unreliable at first, but she's actually a dependable Student Council comrade!」
Yeah. I kinda feel like a real Student Council President right now!

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph」
Snorting as if in disdain, Azel looked away from me and started walking.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, ah...」
He vanished as if he'd been wiped out of existence.
I looked around, but he was nowhere to be found.
And unlike her, I didn't have Riesling.
